definitions.full: H4851. Mash מַשׁ proper name, of a location or people מַ֑שׁ Gen 10:23 , as son of Aram , Samaritan משא ; ᵐ5 Μοσοχ ; so read in || 1Chr 1:17 for מֶ֑שֶׁךְ ᵑ0 A ᵐ5 L Μοσοχ ; see Kau Kit. Location dubious Bo Mich Mons Mas-ius , north of Nisibis (between Armenia and Mesopotamia), but name not certainly old Aramaic (unknown in Assyrian) compare Di on the passage Assyrian Maš (Syro-Arabic desert Dl Par 242f. ) is hardly possibly, compare מֵשָׁא . מַשָּׁאָה מַשָּׁא, see I. נשׁא
